task: Clean and disinfect all horizontal surfaces (e.g. countertops, work surfaces, etc.)
details: Clean with a disinfectant cleaner. Ensure all surfaces are visibly clean.

task: Clean and disinfect all vertical surfaces (e.g. walls, back of cabinets, etc.)
details: Clean with a disinfectant cleaner. Ensure all surfaces are visibly clean.

task: Clean and disinfect all equipment surfaces (e.g. IV pumps, monitors, etc.)
details: Clean between each use with a disinfectant wipe. Ensure all equipment is visibly clean.

task: Clean and disinfect all computer keyboards, mice, and phones
details: Clean with a disinfectant wipe. Ensure all devices are visibly clean.

task: Empty and clean all trash receptacles
details: Empty trash, clean and re-bag. Do not overfill receptacles.

task: Empty and clean all soiled linen receptacles
details: Empty linen, clean and re-bag. Do not overfill receptacles.

task: Clean all floor surfaces
details: Clean all areas thoroughly with a mop or vacuum. Ensure all areas are visibly clean.

task: Replace privacy curtains
details: Remove old curtains, clean tracks, and hang new curtains.

task: Clean and disinfect all chairs and seating surfaces
details: Clean all chairs with a disinfectant wipe. Ensure they are visibly clean.

task: Clean and disinfect all door handles and push plates
details: Clean all areas thoroughly with a disinfectant wipe.

task: Clean and disinfect all light switches
details: Clean with a disinfectant wipe.

task: Clean and disinfect all bed frames and rails
details: Clean with a disinfectant wipe between each patient.

task: Clean and disinfect all storage drawers and shelving
details: Clean all areas with a disinfectant wipe.

task: Clean and disinfect all sinks and faucets
details: Clean with a disinfectant cleaner. Ensure they are visibly clean.

task: Clean and disinfect all toilets
details: Clean with a toilet bowl cleaner. Ensure they are visibly clean.

task: Restock supplies
details: Restock all necessary supplies (gloves, masks, paper towels, soap, etc.).

task: Clean and disinfect privacy curtains
details: Clean if visibly soiled or after a patient with an infectious disease.

task: Clean and disinfect stretchers/gurneys
details: Clean all surfaces with a disinfectant wipe between each patient.

task: Clean and disinfect wheelchairs
details: Clean all surfaces with a disinfectant wipe between each patient.

task: Clean and disinfect IV poles
details: Clean all surfaces with a disinfectant wipe between each patient.

task: Check and replace sharps containers
details: Check containers and replace when 3/4 full. Ensure new containers are properly labeled.

task: Check and replace biohazard containers
details: Check containers and replace when 3/4 full. Ensure new containers are properly labeled.

task: Clean and disinfect window sills
details: Clean with a disinfectant cleaner. Ensure they are visibly clean.

task: Clean and disinfect window glass
details: Clean with a glass cleaner. Ensure they are visibly clean.
